_doc: Generated by tools/build_scarlet_rig.mjs (do not edit): per fight clip tick 0..len the blade base b and tip t, her chest c, head h and hat crown k as [left, up, forward] blocks from her feet in her own frame; on = the drawn sword shows; f0 = the tick the sword's first key ends at (before it the rig blends in from the pose before the clip); sp / sq = the sword part's translation / left rotation as the client shows them each tick (display frame; the blade runs along its local +y from SWORD.bladeLo to SWORD.tip, the top-level blade).
